Setelah tinggal di Haiti selama beberapa bulan, akhirnya saya mendapat kesempatan untuk mengunjungi dukun setempat. Saat berjalan menyusuri jalan masuknya yang panjang, saya melewati banyak patung dan lambang setan. Sungguh suasananya mencekam. Ketika mendekati kuil voodoo yang terhubung dengan rumahnya, saya melihat dia berdiri di sana mengawasi kedatangan saya. Jantung saya mulai berdebar kencang; saya tahu dia orang yang berkuasa. Lalu dia mulai tertawa. Semakin dekat saya, semakin keras tawanya. Saya agak bingung sampai menyadari bahwa banyak orang dari desa mengikuti saya menyusuri jalan setapak. Mereka sangat tertarik dengan apa yang akan terjadi. Saya menghampiri orang itu, tanpa tahu apa yang akan terjadi selanjutnya.

“Apakah Anda seorang pendeta?” tanyanya.

“Ya, benar,” jawab saya. Sekali lagi, dia mulai tertawa keras.

“Kalian para pendeta semuanya sama,” katanya. “Kalian ingin semua orang datang ke gereja kalian, tetapi gereja kalian tidak punya kuasa! Kalau salah seorang dari kalian jatuh sakit, mereka datang kepada saya. Tidak punya kuasa, kalian orang Kristen!”

Beban berat menghimpit saya, dan saya menjelaskan kepadanya bahwa saya setuju dengannya, tetapi gereja sejati Yesus Kristus akan selalu memiliki kuasa. Alkitab sebenarnya berkata bahwa pintu-pintu gerbang neraka sekalipun tidak akan mengalahkannya.

Inilah awal dari hubungan yang sangat menarik, tetapi saya tidak akan pernah melupakan perkataan itu—yang pastilah berasal dari si jahat sendiri—“Kalian orang Kristen tidak punya kuasa!”

Sejak itu saya telah mengunjungi ratusan gereja dan harus mengakui bahwa pendeta voodoo itu benar. Gereja-gereja Kristen kekurangan kuasa. Tetapi mengapa? Kita tahu bahwa Allah adalah kuasa. Banyak hal sudah kita pahami, penampilan dan perkataan kita baik, tetapi apakah gereja-gereja kita masih memiliki kuasa Allah?

Dalam Perjanjian Lama kita mendapati banyak contoh tentang kuasa dan ketiadaan kuasa. Kita juga dapat belajar bagaimana kita menerima kuasa, dan mengapa kita kehilangannya.

Dalam Yosua pasal 6, kita menemukan kisah yang sudah tidak asing lagi tentang orang Israel dan kota Yerikho. Allah menyuruh Yosua dan semua prajurit mengelilingi kota itu, berjalan mengitarinya satu kali setiap hari selama enam hari. Lalu pada hari ketujuh mereka harus mengelilingi kota itu bukan hanya satu kali, melainkan tujuh kali. Setelah mereka menyelesaikan tujuh putaran mengelilingi kota, para imam harus meniup nafiri mereka.

Kita tahu apa yang terjadi ketika Yosua menaati setiap perintah—tembok-tembok tebal yang tak tertembus itu runtuh. Allah juga memberikan perintah yang tegas kepada Yosua tentang apa yang boleh dan tidak boleh dilakukan para prajurit. Mereka harus menjauhkan diri dari segala sesuatu yang telah dinyatakan Allah terkutuk; semua perak, emas, dan perkakas harus dikuduskan bagi perbendaharaan Tuhan; tidak seorang pun boleh mengambil barang jarahan.

Namun, Akhan melihat beberapa barang bagus yang diinginkannya. Dia menyelipkannya ke dalam baju zirahnya, lalu kemudian menyembunyikannya di bawah kemahnya, dan tak seorang pun melihat apa-apa.

Setelah kemenangan besar ini, Yosua mengirim mata-mata ke kota berikutnya, Ai, untuk mengetahui seberapa kuat pertahanan kota itu. Orang-orang itu kembali dan memberi tahu Yosua agar tidak mengirim semua prajurit ke Ai, sebab hanya sedikit pembela yang melindungi kota itu.

Namun, orang-orang Ai mengalahkan orang Israel dan mengusir mereka. Selain itu, Yosua mengoyakkan pakaiannya dan berseru kepada Allah. Kemudian Allah menjawab bahwa ada dosa di perkemahan Israel.

Dalam Perjanjian Lama, orang Israel biasanya menjadi gambaran gereja Yesus Kristus pada masa kini. Bukankah banyak yang dapat kita pelajari dari kisah ini? Ketika tidak ada dosa di perkemahan (atau di gereja), umat Allah memperoleh kemenangan penuh; tidak seorang pun gugur. Mereka melakukan banyak hal yang menakjubkan, menghancurkan semua musuh di sekeliling mereka, dan hidup dalam kemenangan SEPENUHNYA. Namun, begitu dosa masuk ke tengah-tengah mereka, bahkan dosa kecil yang dilakukan oleh satu orang, mereka kehilangan kuasa. Mereka tidak lagi menang atas musuh-musuh mereka.

Berikut ini adalah gambaran yang gamblang tentang bagaimana orang Israel menangani dosa yang telah masuk ke perkemahan. Dosa itu dimusnahkan sama sekali.

Yosua dan seluruh Israel yang menyertainya mengambil Akhan bin Zerah, perak itu, jubah itu, emas batangan itu, anak-anaknya laki-laki dan perempuan, lembu-lembunya, keledai-keledainya, kambing domba-dombanya, kemahnya, dan segala miliknya. Mereka membawa semuanya ke lembah Akhor … Seluruh Israel melempari dia dengan batu, lalu membakar mereka dengan api… –Yosua 7:24-26.

Dalam kisah ini jelas mengapa umat Allah kehilangan kuasa—ada dosa di perkemahan. Jelas juga apa yang harus mereka lakukan untuk mendapatkan kembali kuasa yang telah hilang itu—menyingkirkan dosa.

Dalam pasal 8 kita membaca bahwa kuasa Israel segera dipulihkan setelah dosa itu ditangani. Sekali lagi, mereka hidup dalam kemenangan!

Bagian lain dalam Perjanjian Lama yang membahas topik ini terdapat dalam Imamat pasal 13 dan 14. Kusta adalah penyakit yang aneh. Jika seseorang terkena kusta, penyakit itu mudah menular. Karena itu, perlu ada pedoman yang tegas mengenai cara menangani penyakit tersebut. Imam harus memeriksa dengan sangat teliti untuk mengetahui apakah orang yang bersangkutan memang menderita kusta atau tidak. Jika imam tidak yakin, ia akan mengurung orang itu selama tujuh hari, lalu memeriksanya lagi. Jika dipastikan bahwa orang itu menderita kusta, ia harus diasingkan ke luar kota.

Ketika Paulus berbicara kepada jemaat di Korintus, ia memberi tahu mereka bahwa ia mendengar ada dosa di dalam jemaat. Ia tampak terkejut karena jemaat itu menganggapnya begitu sepele, …Tidak tahukah kamu bahwa sedikit ragi mengkhamiri seluruh adonan? Buanglah ragi yang lama itu, supaya kamu menjadi adonan yang baru, sebab kamu memang tidak beragi… –1 Korintus 5:6-7. Kemudian ia berkata kepada jemaat itu, …Karena itu, singkirkanlah orang jahat itu dari tengah-tengah kamu –1 Korintus 5:13.

Bayangkan jika kamu mendengar kabar bahwa kusta kembali menjadi masalah di desamu. Penyakit yang menghancurkan daging ini kembali merebak dan banyak orang dari desamu kini terinfeksi. Lalu pada hari Minggu pagi kamu sedang duduk di gereja, ketika pintu terbuka dan seorang pria masuk dengan kulit dan daging yang menggantung dari anggota-anggota tubuhnya. Ia terinfeksi parah, tetapi tampaknya ia tidak menyadarinya. Apa yang akan kamu lakukan? Bagaimana jika ia ingin duduk di sampingmu? Bagaimana jika ia ingin berbicara dengan anak-anakmu? Kurasa kita semua tahu apa yang akan kita lakukan; kita tidak akan membiarkannya berada di tengah-tengah kita. Kita terlalu mengasihi sesama dan keluarga kita untuk membiarkan hal itu.

Bagaimana dengan dosa? Apakah kita membiarkan dosa datang dan bergabung dengan kita? Apakah kita menanggapinya dengan sungguh-sungguh? Mana yang lebih buruk, terinfeksi penyakit yang menghancurkan daging, atau terinfeksi dosa yang menghancurkan jiwa? Ingatlah, upah dosa adalah maut—kematian rohani; kematian kekal. Jika kita menangani dosa dengan cara yang sama seperti kita menangani penyakit itu (dan memang seharusnya demikian), maka gereja-gereja kita akan kembali memiliki kuasa Roh Kudus.

Alkitab berkata …kamu akan menerima kuasa, kalau Roh Kudus turun ke atas kamu, dan kamu akan menjadi saksi-Ku di Yerusalem, dan di seluruh Yudea dan Samaria dan sampai ke ujung bumi –Kisah Para Rasul 1:8.

Kita sudah melihat bagaimana dosa memisahkan kita dari kuasa Allah, dan kita juga telah melihat bagaimana Allah ingin memberi kita kuasa. Dia ingin kita menang atas musuh—si jahat, dunia, dan daging. Namun, tampaknya sesuatu sedang terjadi di gereja-gereja kita—kita membiarkan dosa masuk. Kita sering mendengar seorang pengkhotbah berkata, “Tidak ada yang sempurna.” Atau, “Kita semua berdosa.” Oh, seandainya kita menyadari kerusakan yang dapat ditimbulkan oleh pernyataan-pernyataan ini. Yesus datang untuk menyelamatkan kita dari SEGALA dosa; SEGALA ketidakbenaran. Jika kita dibiarkan terus hidup dalam dosa, apa yang telah Yesus lakukan bagi kita?

Saya mendengar tentang gereja-gereja yang hanyut ke dalam dunia. Perlahan-lahan mereka melepaskan keyakinan mereka dan membiarkan mode serta kemegahan dunia masuk. Jarang saya mendengar tentang gereja yang hancur karena dosa besar, seperti percabulan atau kemabukan. Musuh jiwa kita ingin kita menjadi suam-suam kuku. Ia ingin gereja kehilangan kuasanya dan mulai hidup seperti orang lain. Di sini, di Haiti, gereja ada di mana-mana. Pada hari Minggu pagi, mulai pukul lima, saya mulai mendengar gereja-gereja bernyanyi dan beribadah. Namun, di manakah semua orang itu pada Senin pagi? Mereka kembali berbaur dengan dunia tempat mereka berasal.

Baru-baru ini saya berbicara dengan seorang pria Haiti yang sangat kaya, yang memiliki resor dan properti di seluruh Haiti. Saya bertanya kepadanya apakah ia seorang Kristen. (Saya ingin memulai percakapan.) Saya bisa melihat bahwa ia ingin menjawab ya; sebaliknya, ia menjadi kesal dan berkata tidak. Saya bertanya mengapa tidak. Ia menjawab persis seperti yang saya duga. “Saya ingin menjadi orang Kristen, saya sudah pergi ke semua gereja di sekitar sini, tetapi saya merasa mereka tidak punya apa-apa untuk ditawarkan kepada saya. Saya punya uang; saya punya berkat jasmani; tetapi sepertinya hanya itulah yang mereka cari.”

Jika gereja-gereja kita hari ini menolak untuk puas dengan apa pun yang kurang dari dipenuhi, dikuatkan, dan dipimpin oleh Roh Kudus—kepenuhan kuasa surgawi—maka kita akan mampu menawarkan sesuatu yang menarik bagi orang-orang terhilang di sekitar kita. Saya percaya inilah tepatnya yang dicari dunia; mereka mencari sesuatu yang lebih baik, sesuatu yang supranatural. Bagaimana jika kita tidak mau menerima apa pun yang kurang dari itu? Bagaimana jika kita tetap berlutut sampai kuasa Allah kembali? Bagaimana jika kita kembali menangisi jiwa kita dan jiwa orang lain?

Saya bekerja erat dengan seorang pemimpin geng kejam yang tinggal di desa tetangga. Ia berhati keras, tetapi Allah telah menuntunnya kepada saya. Selama tujuh bulan yang panjang kami bertemu dan berkomunikasi. Saya ingin ia melihat sekilas kuasa Allah; saya ingin Allah menyelamatkannya. Ia sering mabuk dan mengancam akan membunuh saya; saya terus mengarahkannya kepada Sang Juru Selamat. Suatu hari ia dan gengnya datang untuk menghentikan proyek pekerjaan, dengan mengatakan bahwa sekarang tanah itu milik mereka. Mereka mengacungkan senjata dan mengancam semua orang yang ada di sana. Saya menjelaskan kepadanya bahwa tanah itu milik Allah. Ia berkata, “Baiklah; suruh Allah turun ke sini, dan akan kupenggal kepala-Nya.” Saya terguncang mendengar ucapan itu dan bertanya apakah ia memahami kuasa Allah yang baru saja diancamnya. Suatu siang saya berkendara ke rumahnya, lalu kami duduk di luar dan berbicara. Hari itu Allah menuntun saya untuk menyampaikan pesan yang tegas kepadanya. “Kamu harus meninggalkan kehidupan geng ini. Allah ingin menyelamatkanmu dan mengubah hatimu!” Ia tampak sangat sadar saat saya melanjutkan, “Kamu tidak pernah tahu kapan seseorang akan datang ke sini dan membunuhmu! Kamu tidak bisa mengendalikan itu, tetapi temanku, kamu bisa menentukan ke mana kamu pergi setelah mati!” Lalu saya mengingatkannya tentang hal mengerikan yang telah ia katakan beberapa hari sebelumnya.

Saat kami masih berbicara, dua orang dari geng tetangga mendekat dengan sepeda motor. Mereka bersenjata lengkap; mereka datang tepat pada saat itu untuk membunuhnya, tetapi melihat saya sedang berbicara dengannya, lalu menunggu sampai saya pergi. “Kamu punya istri dan anak-anak, apakah kamu tidak lelah hidup seperti ini? Allah punya sesuatu yang jauh lebih baik untukmu!” Saya memohon, memohon demi jiwanya. Itulah kesempatan terakhirnya, maut sudah menanti di ambang pintu. Saat pergi, saya berkata bahwa saya akan kembali.

Setelah penembakan itu, saya bergegas kembali, tetapi semuanya sudah berakhir… benar-benar berakhir.

Ketika kita hidup dalam kuasa kebangkitan, kuasa Allah Yang Mahakuasa, saat itulah Dia bekerja! Saya merasa masih begitu banyak pekerjaan yang harus dilakukan sebelum Tuhan datang kembali, tetapi umat Allah terlalu sibuk, kita tidak punya waktu.

Apakah kita takut berbicara tentang kuasa Allah dan Roh Kudus hanya karena gerakan Pentakosta telah memutarbalikkan ajaran Alkitab? Kiranya Allah menolong kita.

Ketika kita berseru kepada Allah memohon keselamatan, kita melakukannya karena tahu bahwa kita perlu diselamatkan; diubahkan. Kita juga tahu bahwa kita tidak dapat menyelamatkan diri sendiri, maka kita meminta pertolongan Allah. Lalu ketika Allah menolong kita, kita mampu melakukan hal-hal yang sebelumnya tidak mampu kita lakukan! Orang-orang yang pemarah tidak lagi marah. Orang-orang yang tidak mampu mengendalikan hawa nafsunya kini mampu mengendalikannya. Orang-orang egois mulai mendahulukan orang lain. Orang-orang pemalu mulai berkhotbah dengan berani. Orang-orang tamak mulai memberi kepada orang lain. Allah melakukan pekerjaan yang tidak dapat dilakukan oleh konselor dan dokter: Dia mengubah inti diri seseorang, dan kemudian segala sesuatu menjadi baru. Kini kita hidup untuk sesuatu yang jauh lebih baik daripada yang dapat diberikan dunia ini; dengan kuasa Allah kita bangkit mengatasi semuanya dan menunjukkan kepada dunia yang sakit karena dosa ini bahwa ada jalan yang lebih baik!

Di sepanjang Alkitab, umat Allah melakukan hal-hal supranatural; mereka tidak puas hanya dengan kehidupan yang nyaman. Mereka mencari sesuatu yang lebih besar, sesuatu yang lebih baik. Ada kuasa dalam darah Yesus, tetapi saliblah yang memungkinkan hal itu. Kita juga harus memikul salib agar menemukan kuasa itu. Dan Ia berkata kepada mereka semua: “Setiap orang yang mau mengikut Aku, ia harus menyangkal dirinya, memikul salibnya setiap hari dan mengikut Aku. Karena barangsiapa mau menyelamatkan nyawanya, ia akan kehilangan nyawanya; tetapi barangsiapa kehilangan nyawanya karena Aku, ia akan menyelamatkannya –Lukas 9:23-24. Ya, hal itu tampak bodoh bagi mereka yang binasa, tetapi bagi mereka yang percaya, itu adalah Kuasa Allah.

I’ll walk with God—Today—
Tomorrow may not be.
I’ll make the best of TIME—right now—
That God has granted me.

I’ll plan not for a life
That I might live in ease,
But only for today to live
My God alone to please.

Nor dare I think in years
Or move from leaps to bounds;
With God shut out, and self shut in
And selfish aims surround.

There are those who plan their lives,
Who give God little thought;
Who weigh themselves, not with God’s truth,
As every day they ought!

“Boast not thyself,” I’m warned,
“Of what tomorrow brings;
Thy health and wealth—e’en life itself—
May all at once take wings!”

“This night, that soul of thine
May be required of thee:
And dost thou plan the New Year full
There, ‘neath some Christmas tree?”

“Wake up! Take stock, are you prepared?
Your lessons learned alright?
If God, in yet three hours, THIS DAY,
Should close your course TONIGHT?”

Je marcherai avec Dieu — aujourd’hui —
Demain n’est peut-être pas.
Je tirerai le meilleur du TEMPS — maintenant —
Que Dieu m’a accordé.

Je ne ferai pas de projets pour une vie
Que je pourrais vivre dans l’aisance,
Mais seulement pour vivre aujourd’hui
En cherchant à plaire à mon Dieu seul.

Je n’oserai pas penser en années
Ni avancer à pas de géant ;
Dieu exclu, et moi enfermé en moi-même,
Entouré d’ambitions égoïstes.

Certains planifient leur vie,
Pensent peu à Dieu ;
Ils se mesurent, non à la vérité de Dieu,
Comme ils le devraient chaque jour !

« Ne te glorifie pas », m’avertit-on,
« De ce que demain apportera ;
Ta santé et ta richesse — et même ta vie —
Peuvent toutes s’envoler d’un coup ! »

« Cette nuit, ton âme
Peut t’être redemandée :
Et projettes-tu déjà toute la nouvelle année
Là, sous un sapin de Noël ? »

« Réveille-toi ! Fais le point : es-tu prêt ?
As-tu bien tiré les leçons ?
Si Dieu, dans trois heures encore, CE JOUR,
Devait mettre fin à ta course CE SOIR ? »

The grinding sound of truck tires driving in the gravel lane filled the air as I sat in the house reading an encyclopedia. Leaping to my feet, I peered out the window.

Mom had just returned from the produce auction in Lewisburg with some peaches.

Slamming the door behind me, I raced across the thick green grass and leaped onto the bed of our truck.

On the back of the pickup sat four boxes of peaches. Grinning triumphantly, I reached into a box searching until I found a ripe one. Just before I bit into it, Mom said, “Steven, don’t eat any peaches; it will ruin your supper.” Sadly, I tossed the peach back into the box and then slowly walked away.

Several hours later, Dad called from the veal barn. “Steven, go pick the radishes for our Friday market produce stand.”

After picking, washing, and banding the radishes, I carried them into the old cooler which was inside the red bank barn. The cooler door squeaked as I yanked it open. There along the cooler walls sat the four boxes of the tantalizing peaches. I stared at the peaches, my mouth watering. I quickly set the radishes down. Oh, how good they looked. Surely a little peach wouldn’t ruin a starving ten-year-old’s supper. Mom wouldn’t know if I only took one peach.

Deep in my heart, a battle between right and wrong started to develop. I knew that sneaking was wrong, but those peaches looked way too good.

After devouring the peach, I scanned the dark interior of the barn for a good hiding place to put the peach stone. I looked across the onions, laying on drying racks, to the open hay bale. The only problem was that if I put the stone under the hay someone could find it. Then I spied the holes in the barn siding boards on the west side of the barn. If I pushed the stone through one of those holes it would land beside the road. Then, if someone saw it, they would think that it came from a passing vehicle.

I jammed the stone through the hole, peering out as it fell beside the road. At that split second, I felt a searing pain on my forehead. Frantically, I sprang back. There above the hole hung a yellow jacket nest. Then I saw the culprit as it hovered over me trying to sting me again. I sprinted out the barn door, slamming the door into the yellow jacket’s face.

That evening my forehead swelled like a balloon, making it difficult to look out of my eyes.

A few hours later, everyone else went to bed. I laid on the couch so that Mom could occasionally check up on me during the night. But I just couldn’t fall asleep. My face was inflamed and itchy, but all that I could think about was the guilt and remorse of what I had done.

After several agonizing hours, I gathered the courage to slide off the couch and tiptoed over to my parent’s bedroom. Awakening my parents, I told them the whole story… how I ate the peach, then tried to hide the stone, and how I had gotten stung.

My parents forgave me, deciding that this was one lesson that I wouldn’t soon forget. Walking back to the couch with a light heart, I laid down, and quickly fell into a peaceful sleep.

Я сидел в доме и читал энциклопедию, когда воздух наполнил скрежещущий звук шин грузовика, ехавшего по гравийной дороге. Я вскочил на ноги и заглянул в окно.

Мама только что вернулась с аукциона сельскохозяйственной продукции в Льюисберге с персиками.

Хлопнув за собой дверью, я помчался по густой зелёной траве и запрыгнул в кузов нашего грузовика.

В кузове пикапа стояли четыре ящика персиков. Торжествующе улыбаясь, я потянулся в один из ящиков и стал искать, пока не нашёл спелый персик. Но прежде чем я успел откусить, мама сказала: «Стивен, не ешь персики — испортишь себе ужин». Огорчённо я положил персик обратно в ящик и медленно отошёл.

Несколько часов спустя папа позвал меня из телятника: «Стивен, собери редис для нашей торговой палатки на пятничном рынке».

Собрав редис, вымыв его и связав в пучки, я отнёс его в старый холодильник, который находился в красном амбаре. Дверь холодильника скрипнула, когда я распахнул её. Там, вдоль стен холодильника, стояли четыре ящика манящих персиков. Я не отрывал от них глаз, и у меня текли слюнки. Я быстро поставил редис на пол. Ах, как же аппетитно они выглядели! Вряд ли один маленький персик испортит ужин десятилетнему мальчику, который умирает с голоду. Мама не узнает, если я возьму всего один персик.

В глубине души во мне разгорелась борьба между добром и злом. Я знал, что красть нехорошо, но эти персики выглядели уж слишком заманчиво.

Проглотив персик, я стал осматривать тёмное нутро амбара в поисках укромного места, куда можно было бы спрятать косточку. Я посмотрел на лук, лежавший на сушильных стеллажах, а затем — на открытую тюковку сена. Но если засунуть косточку под сено, её могут найти. Тут я заметил отверстия в обшивочных досках западной стены амбара. Если протолкнуть косточку в одно из них, она упадёт у дороги. И если кто-нибудь её увидит, то подумает, что она выпала из проезжавшей машины.

Я протолкнул косточку в отверстие и выглянул наружу, наблюдая, как она падает у дороги. В ту же секунду я почувствовал жгучую боль во лбу. Я в панике отпрянул. Прямо над отверстием висело гнездо жёлтых ос. Затем я увидел виновницу: она кружила надо мной, пытаясь ужалить снова. Я бросился к двери амбара и захлопнул её прямо перед носом осы.

В тот вечер мой лоб распух, как воздушный шар, и мне было трудно смотреть.

Через несколько часов все остальные легли спать. Я лежал на диване, чтобы мама могла время от времени проверять, как я себя чувствую, в течение ночи. Но уснуть я никак не мог. Лицо распухло и зудело, но я думал только о чувстве вины и раскаянии из-за того, что натворил.

После нескольких мучительных часов я набрался смелости, соскользнул с дивана и на цыпочках подошёл к спальне родителей. Разбудив их, я рассказал всё как было… как съел персик, потом попытался спрятать косточку и как меня ужалила оса.

Родители простили меня, решив, что этот урок я не скоро забуду. С лёгким сердцем я вернулся к дивану, лёг и быстро погрузился в спокойный сон.

Greetings of Christian love to each one. Another year has passed us by, and another is spread out before us to navigate. What is our perspective? Do we have hope and joy bubbling up in our hearts or does the future seem full of gloom and doom? Do we see God’s sovereign hand at work in the situations and circumstances around us or does the world seem out of control from our vantage point?

As I interact with folks from around the country there seems to be a common issue that many folks are struggling with—weariness. Weary of mandates. Weary of shutdowns. Weary of all the bickering and fighting that has surrounded the Covid issue. Weary of…

It appears that many people just “Don’t want to think about it”. Why? I’m really not sure what all the reasons are, but I am sure that each person has one. Let’s remember that God wants us to …be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves –Matthew 10:16.

Here, in the United States of America, Christians have had over 60 years (since World War 2) of relative peace and tranquility. For the most part, we have been left alone to raise our families and worship the God of our fathers according to our conscience. We have enjoyed the separation of Church and State that was implemented at the beginning of our country’s existence. We have been able to work with our hands and earn a living. Many of us have lived off the fat of the land.

Maybe we were living in an artificial bubble. Maybe we have been lulled into a false sense of security. What about our counterparts in countries around the world, what is their reality of living as true Christians in their world? Sure, we have been able to use our wealth and freedom of movement to do much good for the rest of the world who have endured much hardship due to following Christ. But at what cost? What have our children learned?

Sometimes, we hear about first generation Christians being “on fire” for their Lord. Sometimes so much so that second and third generation Christians think that first generation Christians are perhaps a little too zealous in their efforts of evangelizing those around them.

What about the next generation? They are learning from someone—about God, themselves, and life. What are they learning? And who are they learning from? We must take stock to ensure that our children are learning life’s lessons in a way that they will be prepared to face the reality of things to come.

And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world? And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many –Matthew 24:3-5.

Remember that this is Jesus Himself speaking to His followers regarding the end of the world. His very first concern is that we would NOT be deceived. He says that deception will be the major issue surrounding the end of time. He says that many will come claiming to be Christ [or His direct spokesperson] in an attempt to gain a listening ear, all in an effort to deceive the hearer and gain a following.

If not before now, we most certainly must be teaching our children certain specific things through word and action. That we are to be strangers and pilgrims as we journey through this life. That if we are friends of this world then God will be our enemy. And that Jesus’ Kingdom is not of this world, therefore, His children must learn to live as ambassadors in a foreign land. Our children need to know that ALL who live godly in Christ Jesus WILL suffer persecution.

Many of the doctrines that have been taught in our churches and para-church functions have severely crippled the next generation of the church. We have been taught that we can have the “power of His resurrection” without needing to be a partaker of the “fellowship of His sufferings”. A suffering Christ with suffering followers has been thrown out in favor of following a Jesus who will not let anything bad happen to you. While there is much emphasis on a Jesus who suffered and died for you, there is very little to NO teaching on the need to “take up your cross daily” and follow Him.

Mental Health and Emotional Stability

Some years ago, I came across the story of a soldier, who, after serving a term of service in Iraq, was struggling to cope with PTSD. Sure, I believe that PTSD is real, and the struggles are real, but as I read this man’s story, I found myself becoming increasingly frustrated with the lack of answers that were being provided to a severely struggling young man. Some of his deepest struggles stemmed from the flashback memories he had of when he had personally killed several of the enemy. No matter how many counseling sessions he went to he just couldn’t come to a place of inner peace and rest. His mind was troubled. He had difficulty sleeping. He had problems getting along with others.

I had to think “If only someone could come alongside this young man and share the Gospel of Jesus Christ with him. If only he could be shown the Truth of God’s Word that to take another human’s life is sin in God’s eyes (even if he is the enemy) and God will not allow him to have peace in his heart until that is taken care of. Also, that the real excitement is that IF he would come to God according to the terms of the Bible and repent of his sin, then he could start walking with God and God could start giving him peace for his troubled soul.”

Over the last number of years, there have been numerous mass shootings here in the United States. Each time the public officials hold news conferences and share their thoughts in an effort to try to make sense out of another seemingly unexplainable tragic event. Usually, it’s not long until someone is talking about mental health and the need to step up public efforts to provide safety nets, screenings, and better and more treatments to curb this senseless violence.

Several weeks ago, there was a terrible, tragic event that took place in another state from where I live. In one of the big cities, a man pushed a woman off of the platform and into the path of an oncoming subway train. She didn’t survive. In the aftermath of such a horrific happening, the public officials made statements to the public in an effort to stem the potential public fear. They concluded that the man must have been emotionally troubled and that they would be stepping up their efforts in trying to provide a safety net for those with mental health issues, so that such things wouldn’t happen again.

Sure, when we look at the issue through the eyes of the world it seems to make sense. But is this the whole of the matter? Have we as Christians become so used to the ways of the world that we forget how far they have strayed from the Truth of God’s Word?

Let’s not point our finger at the world and the elected public officials. Are we, as the church, any better? How well do we know our Bible? How well do we know our Savior? When someone comes to us seeking peace and rest within do we know how to take them to the Scriptures, and lead them to Jesus who can then show them the way to the Father?

Why am I saying all this? If we continue to provide the next generation of the church with artificial answers and temporary solutions to the problems of life, then they will NOT be prepared to …endure unto the end… –Matthew 24:13.

And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me. For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it –Luke 9:23-24.

Χαιρετισμούς χριστιανικής αγάπης στον καθένα σας. Πέρασε άλλη μια χρονιά και άλλη μία απλώνεται μπροστά μας, για να τη διανύσουμε. Ποια είναι η οπτική μας; Αναβλύζουν μέσα στην καρδιά μας ελπίδα και χαρά ή το μέλλον μοιάζει γεμάτο σκοτάδι και συμφορές; Βλέπουμε το κυρίαρχο χέρι του Θεού να ενεργεί στις καταστάσεις και στις περιστάσεις γύρω μας ή, από τη δική μας οπτική γωνία, ο κόσμος μοιάζει ανεξέλεγκτος;

Καθώς συνομιλώ με ανθρώπους από όλη τη χώρα, φαίνεται να υπάρχει ένα κοινό ζήτημα με το οποίο παλεύουν πολλοί: η εξάντληση. Έχουν κουραστεί από τις εντολές. Έχουν κουραστεί από τα lockdown. Έχουν κουραστεί από όλες τις διαφωνίες και τις συγκρούσεις που συνόδευσαν το ζήτημα της Covid. Έχουν κουραστεί από…

Φαίνεται πως πολλοί άνθρωποι απλώς «δεν θέλουν να το σκέφτονται». Γιατί; Δεν είμαι πραγματικά βέβαιος ποιοι είναι όλοι οι λόγοι, αλλά είμαι βέβαιος ότι ο καθένας έχει τον δικό του. Ας θυμόμαστε ότι ο Θεός θέλει να …είστε λοιπόν φρόνιμοι σαν τα φίδια και ακέραιοι σαν τα περιστέρια –Ματθαίος 10:16.

Εδώ, στις Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες της Αμερικής, οι Χριστιανοί έχουν απολαύσει πάνω από 60 χρόνια (από τον Β΄ Παγκόσμιο Πόλεμο) σχετικής ειρήνης και ηρεμίας. Ως επί το πλείστον, μας έχουν αφήσει ήσυχους να μεγαλώνουμε τις οικογένειές μας και να λατρεύουμε τον Θεό των πατέρων μας σύμφωνα με τη συνείδησή μας. Έχουμε απολαύσει τον διαχωρισμό Εκκλησίας και Κράτους, που θεσπίστηκε στις αρχές της ύπαρξης της χώρας μας. Μπορούσαμε να δουλεύουμε με τα χέρια μας και να κερδίζουμε τα προς το ζην. Πολλοί από εμάς ζήσαμε μέσα στην αφθονία της γης.

Ίσως ζούσαμε μέσα σε μια τεχνητή φούσκα. Ίσως μας έχουν αποκοιμίσει και μας έχουν κάνει να νιώθουμε μια ψεύτικη ασφάλεια. Τι γίνεται με τους ομοπίστους μας σε χώρες σε όλο τον κόσμο; Ποια είναι η πραγματικότητα της ζωής τους ως αληθινών Χριστιανών στον κόσμο τους; Βεβαίως, μπορέσαμε να χρησιμοποιήσουμε τον πλούτο μας και την ελευθερία μετακίνησης για να κάνουμε πολύ καλό στους υπόλοιπους ανθρώπους του κόσμου, που έχουν υπομείνει πολλές κακουχίες επειδή ακολουθούν τον Χριστό. Αλλά με ποιο κόστος; Τι έχουν μάθει τα παιδιά μας;

Μερικές φορές ακούμε για Χριστιανούς πρώτης γενιάς που είναι «φλογεροί» για τον Κύριό τους. Μερικές φορές μάλιστα τόσο πολύ, ώστε οι Χριστιανοί δεύτερης και τρίτης γενιάς θεωρούν ότι οι Χριστιανοί πρώτης γενιάς ίσως είναι κάπως υπερβολικά ζηλωτές στις προσπάθειές τους να ευαγγελίζονται τους γύρω τους.

Τι γίνεται με την επόμενη γενιά; Μαθαίνουν από κάποιον — για τον Θεό, τον εαυτό τους και τη ζωή. Τι μαθαίνουν; Και από ποιον μαθαίνουν; Πρέπει να εξετάσουμε προσεκτικά τα πράγματα, ώστε να διασφαλίσουμε ότι τα παιδιά μας μαθαίνουν τα μαθήματα της ζωής με τρόπο που θα τα προετοιμάσει να αντιμετωπίσουν την πραγματικότητα όσων έρχονται.

Και ενώ καθόταν στο Όρος των Ελαιών, οι μαθητές ήρθαν κοντά του ιδιαιτέρως, λέγοντας: Πες μας, πότε θα γίνουν αυτά; Και ποιο θα είναι το σημείο της έλευσής σου και της συντέλειας του κόσμου; Και ο Ιησούς αποκρίθηκε και τους είπε: Προσέχετε να μη σας εξαπατήσει κανείς. Επειδή πολλοί θα έρθουν στο όνομά μου, λέγοντας: Εγώ είμαι ο Χριστός· και θα εξαπατήσουν πολλούς –Ματθαίος 24:3-5.

Να θυμάστε ότι αυτά τα λέει ο ίδιος ο Ιησούς στους ακολούθους του σχετικά με τη συντέλεια του κόσμου. Πρώτο του μέλημα είναι να ΜΗΝ εξαπατηθούμε. Λέει ότι η εξαπάτηση θα είναι το κύριο ζήτημα που θα περιβάλλει το τέλος των καιρών. Λέει ότι πολλοί θα έρθουν ισχυριζόμενοι πως είναι ο Χριστός [ή ο άμεσος εκπρόσωπός του], προσπαθώντας να κερδίσουν την προσοχή μας, με σκοπό να εξαπατήσουν τον ακροατή και να αποκτήσουν οπαδούς.

Αν δεν το κάναμε ήδη, οπωσδήποτε πρέπει τώρα να διδάσκουμε στα παιδιά μας ορισμένα συγκεκριμένα πράγματα με τα λόγια και τις πράξεις μας. Ότι πρέπει να είμαστε ξένοι και πάροικοι καθώς διανύουμε αυτή τη ζωή. Ότι, αν είμαστε φίλοι αυτού του κόσμου, τότε ο Θεός θα είναι εχθρός μας. Και ότι η Βασιλεία του Ιησού δεν είναι από αυτόν τον κόσμο· επομένως, τα παιδιά του πρέπει να μάθουν να ζουν ως πρεσβευτές σε ξένη γη. Τα παιδιά μας πρέπει να γνωρίζουν ότι ΟΛΟΙ όσοι ζουν με ευσέβεια εν Χριστώ Ιησού ΘΑ υποστούν διωγμό.

Πολλές από τις διδασκαλίες που έχουν παρουσιαστεί στις εκκλησίες μας και στις παραεκκλησιαστικές δραστηριότητές μας έχουν ακρωτηριάσει σοβαρά την επόμενη γενιά της εκκλησίας. Μας έχουν διδάξει ότι μπορούμε να έχουμε τη «δύναμη της ανάστασής του» χωρίς να χρειάζεται να συμμετέχουμε στην «κοινωνία των παθημάτων του». Έχουν παραμερίσει έναν Χριστό που υποφέρει και ακολούθους που υποφέρουν, προτιμώντας να ακολουθούν έναν Ιησού που δεν θα αφήσει να σου συμβεί τίποτα κακό. Ενώ δίνεται μεγάλη έμφαση στον Ιησού που υπέφερε και πέθανε για χάρη σου, υπάρχει ελάχιστη έως ΚΑΜΙΑ διδασκαλία για την ανάγκη να «σηκώνεις καθημερινά τον σταυρό σου» και να τον ακολουθείς.

Ψυχική υγεία και συναισθηματική σταθερότητα

Πριν από μερικά χρόνια, έπεσα πάνω στην ιστορία ενός στρατιώτη, ο οποίος, αφού υπηρέτησε για μια περίοδο στο Ιράκ, δυσκολευόταν να αντιμετωπίσει τη διαταραχή μετατραυματικού στρες (PTSD). Βεβαίως, πιστεύω ότι το PTSD είναι πραγματικό και ότι οι δυσκολίες είναι πραγματικές, αλλά, καθώς διάβαζα την ιστορία αυτού του ανθρώπου, ένιωθα όλο και πιο απογοητευμένος από την έλλειψη απαντήσεων που δίνονταν σε έναν νεαρό άνδρα που υπέφερε σοβαρά. Μερικές από τις βαθύτερες δυσκολίες του προέρχονταν από τις αναδρομές μνήμης που είχε, όταν θυμόταν ότι είχε σκοτώσει ο ίδιος αρκετούς από τους εχθρούς. Όσες συνεδρίες συμβουλευτικής κι αν παρακολουθούσε, απλώς δεν μπορούσε να φτάσει σε μια κατάσταση εσωτερικής ειρήνης και ανάπαυσης. Ο νους του ήταν ταραγμένος. Δυσκολευόταν να κοιμηθεί. Είχε προβλήματα στις σχέσεις του με τους άλλους.

Σκέφτηκα: «Μακάρι κάποιος να μπορούσε να σταθεί δίπλα σ’ αυτόν τον νεαρό και να του μιλήσει για το Ευαγγέλιο του Ιησού Χριστού. Μακάρι να μπορούσε κάποιος να του δείξει την Αλήθεια του Λόγου του Θεού: ότι το να αφαιρείς τη ζωή ενός άλλου ανθρώπου είναι αμαρτία στα μάτια του Θεού (ακόμη κι αν είναι εχθρός) και ότι ο Θεός δεν θα του επιτρέψει να έχει ειρήνη στην καρδιά του μέχρι να τακτοποιηθεί αυτό το ζήτημα. Και το πραγματικά συναρπαστικό είναι ότι, ΑΝ ερχόταν στον Θεό σύμφωνα με τους όρους της Αγίας Γραφής και μετανοούσε για την αμαρτία του, τότε θα μπορούσε να αρχίσει να περπατά με τον Θεό και ο Θεός θα μπορούσε να αρχίσει να του δίνει ειρήνη για την ταραγμένη ψυχή του».

Τα τελευταία χρόνια έχουν γίνει πολλές μαζικές ένοπλες επιθέσεις εδώ στις Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες. Κάθε φορά, οι δημόσιοι αξιωματούχοι δίνουν συνεντεύξεις Τύπου και μοιράζονται τις σκέψεις τους, προσπαθώντας να βγάλουν νόημα από ένα ακόμη φαινομενικά ανεξήγητο τραγικό γεγονός. Συνήθως, δεν περνά πολύς καιρός μέχρι να αρχίσει κάποιος να μιλά για την ψυχική υγεία και την ανάγκη να ενταθούν οι δημόσιες προσπάθειες για την παροχή δικτύων ασφαλείας, ελέγχων και καλύτερων και περισσότερων θεραπειών, ώστε να περιοριστεί αυτή η παράλογη βία.

Πριν από μερικές εβδομάδες συνέβη ένα φοβερό, τραγικό περιστατικό σε άλλη πολιτεία από εκείνη όπου ζω. Σε μία από τις μεγάλες πόλεις, ένας άνδρας έσπρωξε μια γυναίκα από την αποβάθρα και στις ράγες, μπροστά σε ένα τρένο του μετρό που ερχόταν. Δεν επέζησε. Μετά από ένα τόσο φρικτό συμβάν, οι δημόσιοι αξιωματούχοι απευθύνθηκαν στο κοινό, προσπαθώντας να περιορίσουν τον ενδεχόμενο φόβο του κόσμου. Κατέληξαν στο συμπέρασμα ότι ο άνδρας πρέπει να αντιμετώπιζε συναισθηματικά προβλήματα και ότι θα ενίσχυαν τις προσπάθειές τους να προσφέρουν ένα δίκτυο ασφαλείας σε όσους αντιμετωπίζουν ζητήματα ψυχικής υγείας, ώστε να μην ξανασυμβούν τέτοια πράγματα.

Βεβαίως, όταν εξετάζουμε το ζήτημα μέσα από τα μάτια του κόσμου, φαίνεται να βγάζει νόημα. Είναι όμως αυτή όλη η αλήθεια; Έχουμε εμείς οι Χριστιανοί συνηθίσει τόσο πολύ τους τρόπους του κόσμου, ώστε να ξεχνάμε πόσο έχουν απομακρυνθεί από την Αλήθεια του Λόγου του Θεού;

Ας μην κουνάμε το δάχτυλο στον κόσμο και στους αιρετούς δημόσιους αξιωματούχους. Είμαστε εμείς, ως εκκλησία, καλύτεροι; Πόσο καλά γνωρίζουμε την Αγία Γραφή μας; Πόσο καλά γνωρίζουμε τον Σωτήρα μας; Όταν κάποιος έρχεται σε εμάς αναζητώντας εσωτερική ειρήνη και ανάπαυση, γνωρίζουμε πώς να τον οδηγήσουμε στις Γραφές και να τον οδηγήσουμε στον Ιησού, ο οποίος τότε μπορεί να του δείξει τον δρόμο προς τον Πατέρα;

Γιατί τα λέω όλα αυτά; Αν συνεχίσουμε να προσφέρουμε στην επόμενη γενιά της εκκλησίας τεχνητές απαντήσεις και προσωρινές λύσεις στα προβλήματα της ζωής, τότε ΔΕΝ θα είναι προετοιμασμένη να …υπομείνει μέχρι τέλους… –Ματθαίος 24:13.

Και είπε σε όλους: Αν κάποιος θέλει να έρθει πίσω μου, ας απαρνηθεί τον εαυτό του, κι ας σηκώνει καθημερινά τον σταυρό του, κι ας με ακολουθεί. Επειδή, όποιος θέλει να σώσει τη ζωή του, θα τη χάσει· όποιος όμως χάσει τη ζωή του για χάρη μου, αυτός θα τη σώσει –Λουκάς 9:23-24.

After living in Haiti for several months, I finally had the opportunity to go visit the local witch doctor. As I walked up his long drive, I passed many statues and satanic symbols. It was eerie for sure. As I approached the voodoo temple that was connected to his house, I saw him standing there watching me approach. My heart began to race; I knew he was a powerful man. Then he began to laugh. The closer I got, the louder he laughed. I was a bit puzzled until I realized that many people from the village were following me up the lane. They were very interested in what was about to transpire. I approached the man, not knowing what would happen next.

“Are you a pastor?” he asked.

“Yes, I am,” was my reply. Again, he began to laugh loudly.

“You pastors are all the same,” he proclaimed. “You want everyone to come to your churches, but your churches have no power! When one of your people gets sick, they come to me. No power, you Christians!”

A heavy burden overtook me, and I explained to him how I agreed with him, but that the real church of Jesus Christ would always have power. The Bible actually says that the very gates of Hell shall not prevail against it.

This was the beginning of a very interesting relationship, but I will never forget those words—most certainly from the devil himself—“You Christians have no power!”

I have since traveled to hundreds of churches and need to agree with that voodoo priest. The Christian churches are lacking power. But why? We know that God is power. We have many things figured out, we look good and sound good, but do we still have the power of God in our churches?

In the Old Testament we have many examples of power and the lack of power. We can also learn how we receive power, and why we lose it.

In Joshua, chapter 6, we have the familiar account of the children of Israel and the city of Jericho. God tells Joshua and all the men of war to compass the city, and walk around it once every day, for six days. Then on the seventh day they were to march around the city not just once, but seven times. After they had completed the seven trips around the city, the priests were to blow their trumpets.

We know what happened when Joshua obeyed each command—those thick, impenetrable walls came tumbling down. God also gave Joshua a strict command about what the men should and should not do. They were to keep themselves from everything that God had pronounced was accursed; all the silver, gold, and vessels were to be consecrated into the treasury of the Lord; no man was to take any of the spoil.

However, Achan saw some nice things that he desired. He slipped them into his armor, then later hid them under his tent, and no one saw a thing.

After this great victory, Joshua sent spies to the next city, Ai, to discover how well the city was fortified. The men returned and told Joshua not to send all the men to Ai, for there were only a few defenders protecting the city.

However, the men of Ai smote the children of Israel and chased them away. Moreover, Joshua rent his clothes and cried out to God. Then God replied that there was sin in the camp of Israel.

In the Old Testament, the children of Israel are normally representative of the church of Jesus Christ today. Can we not glean much from this account? When there was no sin in the camp (or in the church) God’s people had complete victory; they lost not one. They did many wonderful things, they destroyed all their enemies around them, and they lived in COMPLETE victory. However, as soon as sin entered into their midst, even a small sin done by one man, they lost their power. They no longer had victory over their enemies.

What follows is a graphic description of how the children of Israel dealt with the sin that had entered the camp. It was totally destroyed.

And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor … And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire… –Joshua 7:24-26.

In this account it is clear why God’s people had lost their power—they had sin in the camp. It is also clear what it took for them to regain that power which they had lost—get rid of the sin.

In chapter 8 we read of the power being restored to Israel instantly after the sin was dealt with. Again, they lived in victory!

Another passage in the Old Testament that speaks of this topic is in Leviticus chapters 13 and 14. Leprosy was a strange disease. If one were to get leprosy, it was easily spread. Thus, there needed to be some strict guidelines regarding how to deal with the disease. The priest was to examine very closely to see if the person in question indeed had leprosy or not. If the priest was unsure, he would shut the person up in a room for seven days then examine him again. If it was determined that the person had leprosy, then they were sent outside of the city.

As Paul addresses the church in Corinth, he tells them that he has heard there is sin in the church. He seems surprised that the church is taking it so casually, …Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump? Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened… –1 Corinthians 5:6-7. Later he tells the church …Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person –1 Corinthians 5:13.

Let’s say that you heard the news that leprosy was again a problem in your village. This flesh-destroying disease had made a comeback and many from your village were now infected. Then you’re sitting in church on Sunday morning, when the doors open, and a man enters with skin and flesh hanging from his extremities. He is badly infected, but he does not seem to know it. What would you do? What if he wanted to come sit by you? What if he wanted to talk to your children? I think we all know what we would do; we would not allow him into our midst. We love our people, our families too much for that.

What about sin? Do we allow sin to come and join us? Do we take it seriously? What is worse, being infected with a flesh-destroying disease, or being infected by a soul-destroying sin? Remember, the wages of sin is death—spiritual death; eternal death. If we would treat sin in the same way as we would the disease (and we should) then our churches would once again have Holy Spirit power.

The Bible says …ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth –Acts 1:8.

We have already seen how sin separates us from the power of God, and we have also seen how God wants to give us power. He wants us to have victory over the enemy—the devil, the world, and flesh. However, something seems to be happening in our churches—we are allowing sin to enter. It is common to hear a preacher say, “No one is perfect.” Or, “We all sin.” Oh, that we would realize the damage these statements can make. Jesus came to save us from ALL sin; ALL unrighteousness. If we are left to continue in our sin, what has Jesus done for us?

I hear about churches drifting into the world. They gradually let go of convictions and allow some new fashion and pomp of the world to enter. Something that I hear little of is churches falling apart because of gross sin, such as fornication or drunkenness. The enemy of our souls, desires for us to become lukewarm. He wants the church to lose its power, to start living like everyone else. Here in Haiti, there are churches everywhere. On Sunday mornings starting at five o’clock in the morning, I start hearing the churches singing and worshipping. However, where are all those people on Monday morning? They are mixing right back into the world from whence they have come.

I was recently talking to a very wealthy Haitian man who owned resorts and properties all over Haiti. I asked him if he was a Christian. (I wanted to start a conversation.) I could tell that he wanted to say yes; instead, he became frustrated and said no. I asked him why not. He said exactly what I thought he would say. “I have desired to become a Christian, I’ve gone to all the churches around here, but I don’t feel they have anything to offer me. I have money; I have physical blessings; but that seems to be all that they are seeking for.”

If our churches today would refuse to settle for anything less than the infilling, empowering, and leading of the Holy Spirit, a full dose of heavenly power, then we would be able to offer something that would appeal to the lost around us. I believe this is exactly what the world is looking for; they are seeking for something better, something supernatural. What if we would settle for nothing less? What if we would stay on our knees until the power of God came back? What if we would again weep for our souls, and the souls of others?

I was working closely with a vicious gang leader who lived in the neighboring village. He was hard, but God had led him to me. For seven long months we met and communicated, I wanted him to catch a glimpse of the power of God; I wanted God to save him. He would often get drunk and threaten to kill me; I would continue to point him to the Savior. He and his gang came over one day to stop a work project, saying that they now owned the land. They brandished their guns and threatened all that were there. I explained to him that God owned the land. He said, “That is fine; tell God to come down here, and I’ll cut off His head.” I was troubled by this remark and asked him if he understood the power of the God he just threatened. One afternoon I drove to his house, and we sat outside and talked. God led me to preach a bold message to him that day. “You need to give up this gang life. God wants to save you, and change your heart!” He seemed very sober as I continued, “You never know when someone will come here and kill you! You can’t control that, but my friend you can control where you go after you are dead!” I then reminded him of the terrible thing he had said days before.

While we were still talking, two men from a neighboring gang approached on motorbikes. They were heavily armed; they had come at that very moment to kill him, but they saw me talking to him and waited for me to leave. “You have a wife and children, are you not tired of this life? God has something so much better for you!” I was pleading, pleading for his soul. It was his very last opportunity, death waited at the door. As I left I told him that I would be back.

After the shooting I rushed back, but it was over… all over.

When we live in the power of the resurrection, the power of the Almighty God, it is then that He works! I feel there is so much work to be done before the Lord returns, but God’s people are too busy, we do not have time.

Do we fear talking about the power of God and the Holy Ghost simply because the Pentecostal movement has twisted what the Bible teaches? God help us.

When we call out to God for salvation, we are doing so because we know we need to be saved; converted. We also know that we cannot save ourselves, so we ask God to help us. Then when God helps us, we are able to do things that we could not do before! Angry people are angry no more. People that could not control their lust now have control. Selfish people begin to put others first. Shy people begin to preach with boldness. Greedy people begin to give to others. God does a work that counselors and doctors cannot do, He changes the very core of a person, and then all things become new. We now live for something far better than what this world has to give; we rise above by the power of God and show this sin-sick world there is a better way!

All through the Bible, God’s people did supernatural things; they did not settle for just a nice life. They sought something bigger, something better. There is power in the blood of Jesus, but it took the cross to make that a possibility. It also takes a cross for us to find that power. And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me. For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it –Luke 9:23-24. Yes, it seems foolish to those that perish, but to those that believe, it is the Power of God.

Después de vivir en Haití durante varios meses, por fin tuve la oportunidad de ir a visitar al hechicero local. Mientras subía por su largo camino de entrada, pasé junto a muchas estatuas y símbolos satánicos. Sin duda, era espeluznante. Al acercarme al templo vudú que estaba conectado con su casa, lo vi allí, de pie, observándome mientras me acercaba. El corazón comenzó a latirme con fuerza; sabía que era un hombre poderoso. Entonces empezó a reírse. Cuanto más me acercaba, más fuerte se reía. Me sentí un poco desconcertado hasta que me di cuenta de que muchas personas de la aldea me seguían por el camino. Tenían mucho interés en lo que estaba a punto de suceder. Me acerqué al hombre sin saber qué ocurriría después.

—¿Es usted pastor? —preguntó.

—Sí, lo soy —respondí. De nuevo, empezó a reírse a carcajadas.

—Todos ustedes, los pastores, son iguales —proclamó—. Quieren que todos vengan a sus iglesias, pero sus iglesias no tienen poder. Cuando alguien de los suyos se enferma, viene a mí. ¡No tienen poder, ustedes los cristianos!

Me embargó una profunda tristeza, y le expliqué que estaba de acuerdo con él, pero que la verdadera iglesia de Jesucristo siempre tendría poder. De hecho, la Biblia dice que ni siquiera las puertas del infierno prevalecerán contra ella.

Así comenzó una relación muy interesante, pero nunca olvidaré aquellas palabras —sin duda, dichas por el mismísimo diablo—: «¡Ustedes los cristianos no tienen poder!».

Desde entonces he viajado a cientos de iglesias y debo estar de acuerdo con ese sacerdote vudú. A las iglesias cristianas les falta poder. Pero ¿por qué? Sabemos que Dios es poder. Tenemos muchas cosas resueltas, nos vemos bien y sonamos bien, pero ¿sigue estando el poder de Dios en nuestras iglesias?

En el Antiguo Testamento encontramos muchos ejemplos de poder y de falta de poder. También podemos aprender cómo recibimos poder y por qué lo perdemos.

En Josué, capítulo 6, encontramos el conocido relato de los hijos de Israel y la ciudad de Jericó. Dios les dice a Josué y a todos los hombres de guerra que rodeen la ciudad y marchen alrededor de ella una vez al día durante seis días. Luego, el séptimo día debían marchar alrededor de la ciudad no una sola vez, sino siete veces. Después de completar las siete vueltas alrededor de la ciudad, los sacerdotes debían tocar sus trompetas.

Sabemos lo que sucedió cuando Josué obedeció cada mandato: aquellos gruesos e impenetrables muros se derrumbaron. Dios también le dio a Josué una orden estricta acerca de lo que los hombres debían y no debían hacer. Debían abstenerse de todo lo que Dios había declarado anatema; toda la plata, el oro y los utensilios debían consagrarse al tesoro del Señor; ningún hombre debía llevarse nada del botín.

Sin embargo, Acán vio algunas cosas bonitas que deseó. Se las metió a escondidas bajo la armadura y luego las escondió debajo de su tienda, sin que nadie viera nada.

Después de esta gran victoria, Josué envió espías a la siguiente ciudad, Hai, para averiguar cuán bien fortificada estaba. Los hombres regresaron y le dijeron a Josué que no enviara a todos los hombres a Hai, pues solo unos pocos defensores protegían la ciudad.

Sin embargo, los hombres de Hai derrotaron a los hijos de Israel y los hicieron huir. Además, Josué rasgó sus vestidos y clamó a Dios. Entonces Dios respondió que había pecado en el campamento de Israel.

En el Antiguo Testamento, los hijos de Israel suelen representar a la iglesia de Jesucristo de hoy. ¿Acaso no podemos aprender mucho de este relato? Cuando no había pecado en el campamento (o en la iglesia), el pueblo de Dios obtenía una victoria completa; no perdían a nadie. Hicieron muchas cosas maravillosas, destruyeron a todos sus enemigos de alrededor y vivieron en VICTORIA COMPLETA. Sin embargo, en cuanto el pecado entró en medio de ellos, aunque fuera un pecado pequeño cometido por un solo hombre, perdieron su poder. Ya no tenían victoria sobre sus enemigos.

Lo que sigue es una descripción gráfica de cómo los hijos de Israel trataron el pecado que había entrado en el campamento. Fue completamente destruido.

Y Josué, y todo Israel con él, tomaron a Acán hijo de Zera, y la plata, y el manto, y el lingote de oro, y sus hijos, y sus hijas, y sus bueyes, y sus asnos, y sus ovejas, y su tienda, y todo lo que tenía; y los llevaron al valle de Acor… Y todo Israel lo apedreó, y los quemó con fuego… –Josué 7:24-26.

En este relato queda claro por qué el pueblo de Dios había perdido su poder: había pecado en el campamento. También queda claro qué tuvieron que hacer para recuperar el poder que habían perdido: deshacerse del pecado.

En el capítulo 8 leemos que el poder de Israel fue restaurado de inmediato después de que se trató el pecado. ¡De nuevo vivieron en victoria!

Otro pasaje del Antiguo Testamento que trata este tema se encuentra en Levítico, capítulos 13 y 14. La lepra era una enfermedad extraña. Si alguien contraía lepra, se propagaba con facilidad. Por eso, era necesario establecer pautas estrictas para tratar la enfermedad. El sacerdote debía examinar cuidadosamente a la persona para determinar si en efecto tenía lepra o no. Si el sacerdote no estaba seguro, encerraba a la persona en una habitación durante siete días y luego la examinaba otra vez. Si se determinaba que la persona tenía lepra, la enviaban fuera de la ciudad.

Al dirigirse a la iglesia de Corinto, Pablo les dice que ha oído que hay pecado en la iglesia. Parece sorprenderle que la iglesia se lo tome con tanta ligereza: …¿No sabéis que un poco de levadura leuda toda la masa? Limpiaos, pues, de la vieja levadura, para que seáis una nueva masa, sin levadura como sois… –1 Corintios 5:6-7. Más adelante les dice a los de la iglesia: …Quitad, pues, a ese malvado de entre vosotros –1 Corintios 5:13.

Supongamos que te enteraras de que la lepra vuelve a ser un problema en tu aldea. Esta enfermedad que destruye la carne ha reaparecido y ahora muchos de los habitantes de tu aldea están infectados. Entonces estás sentado en la iglesia el domingo por la mañana cuando se abren las puertas y entra un hombre con la piel y la carne colgándole de las extremidades. Está gravemente infectado, pero parece no saberlo. ¿Qué harías? ¿Y si quisiera sentarse a tu lado? ¿Y si quisiera hablar con tus hijos? Creo que todos sabemos qué haríamos: no permitiríamos que estuviera entre nosotros. Amamos demasiado a nuestra gente y a nuestras familias como para permitirlo.

¿Y qué hay del pecado? ¿Permitimos que el pecado venga y se una a nosotros? ¿Nos lo tomamos en serio? ¿Qué es peor: estar infectado por una enfermedad que destruye la carne, o estar infectado por un pecado que destruye el alma? Recuerda que la paga del pecado es la muerte: muerte espiritual; muerte eterna. Si tratáramos el pecado del mismo modo que trataríamos esa enfermedad (y así deberíamos hacerlo), nuestras iglesias volverían a tener el poder del Espíritu Santo.

La Biblia dice: …recibiréis poder cuando haya venido sobre vosotros el Espíritu Santo, y me seréis testigos tanto en Jerusalén como en toda Judea, en Samaria y hasta lo último de la tierra –Hechos 1:8.

Ya hemos visto cómo el pecado nos separa del poder de Dios, y también hemos visto que Dios quiere darnos poder. Quiere que tengamos victoria sobre el enemigo: el diablo, el mundo y la carne. Sin embargo, parece que algo está ocurriendo en nuestras iglesias: estamos permitiendo que entre el pecado. Es común oír a un predicador decir: «Nadie es perfecto». O: «Todos pecamos». ¡Ojalá nos diéramos cuenta del daño que pueden causar estas afirmaciones! Jesús vino a salvarnos de TODO pecado; de TODA injusticia. Si se nos deja continuar en nuestro pecado, ¿qué ha hecho Jesús por nosotros?

Oigo hablar de iglesias que se desvían hacia el mundo. Poco a poco abandonan sus convicciones y permiten que entren algunas modas y la ostentación del mundo. De lo que oigo poco es de iglesias que se desmoronan por causa de pecados graves, como la fornicación o la embriaguez. El enemigo de nuestras almas desea que nos volvamos tibios. Quiere que la iglesia pierda su poder y empiece a vivir como todos los demás. Aquí en Haití hay iglesias por todas partes. Los domingos por la mañana, a partir de las cinco, empiezo a oír a las iglesias cantar y adorar. Pero ¿dónde está toda esa gente el lunes por la mañana? Vuelven a mezclarse con el mundo del que salieron.

Hace poco hablaba con un haitiano muy rico que era dueño de complejos turísticos y propiedades por todo Haití. Le pregunté si era cristiano. (Quería iniciar una conversación.) Me di cuenta de que quería decir que sí; en cambio, se frustró y dijo que no. Le pregunté por qué. Dijo exactamente lo que yo pensaba que diría: «He deseado hacerme cristiano; he ido a todas las iglesias de por aquí, pero no siento que tengan nada que ofrecerme. Tengo dinero; tengo bendiciones materiales; pero parece que eso es todo lo que buscan».

Si nuestras iglesias de hoy se negaran a conformarse con algo menos que la plenitud, el poder y la dirección del Espíritu Santo, con una medida completa del poder celestial, entonces podríamos ofrecer algo que atrajera a los perdidos que nos rodean. Creo que eso es exactamente lo que busca el mundo: busca algo mejor, algo sobrenatural. ¿Y si no nos conformáramos con nada menos? ¿Y si permaneciéramos de rodillas hasta que volviera el poder de Dios? ¿Y si volviéramos a llorar por nuestras almas y por las almas de los demás?

Trabajaba estrechamente con el líder de una pandilla violenta que vivía en la aldea vecina. Era un hombre endurecido, pero Dios lo había guiado hasta mí. Durante siete largos meses nos reunimos y mantuvimos contacto; yo quería que vislumbrara el poder de Dios; quería que Dios lo salvara. A menudo se emborrachaba y amenazaba con matarme; yo seguía señalándole al Salvador. Un día, él y su pandilla vinieron a detener un proyecto de trabajo, diciendo que ahora ellos eran dueños del terreno. Blandieron sus armas y amenazaron a todos los que estaban allí. Le expliqué que Dios era el dueño del terreno. Él dijo: «Está bien; dile a Dios que baje aquí, y le cortaré la cabeza». Me inquietó ese comentario y le pregunté si comprendía el poder del Dios a quien acababa de amenazar. Una tarde conduje hasta su casa, y nos sentamos afuera a conversar. Ese día Dios me guio a predicarle un mensaje audaz: «Tienes que abandonar esta vida de pandillero. Dios quiere salvarte y cambiar tu corazón». Parecía muy sobrio mientras yo continuaba: «¡Nunca sabes cuándo alguien vendrá aquí y te matará! No puedes controlar eso, pero, amigo mío, sí puedes controlar adónde irás después de morir». Entonces le recordé lo terrible que había dicho unos días antes.

Mientras todavía conversábamos, se acercaron en motocicletas dos hombres de una pandilla vecina. Iban fuertemente armados; habían venido justo en ese momento a matarlo, pero me vieron hablando con él y esperaron a que me fuera. «Tienes esposa e hijos, ¿no estás cansado de esta vida? ¡Dios tiene algo mucho mejor para ti!». Le suplicaba, le suplicaba por su alma. Era su última oportunidad; la muerte estaba a la puerta. Al irme, le dije que volvería.

Después del tiroteo volví corriendo, pero ya había terminado… todo había terminado.

Cuando vivimos en el poder de la resurrección, en el poder de Dios Todopoderoso, ¡es entonces cuando Él obra! Siento que hay muchísimo trabajo por hacer antes de que el Señor regrese, pero el pueblo de Dios está demasiado ocupado; no tenemos tiempo.

¿Tememos hablar del poder de Dios y del Espíritu Santo simplemente porque el movimiento pentecostal ha tergiversado lo que enseña la Biblia? Dios nos ayude.

Cuando clamamos a Dios por salvación, lo hacemos porque sabemos que necesitamos ser salvos; convertidos. También sabemos que no podemos salvarnos a nosotros mismos, así que le pedimos ayuda a Dios. Entonces, cuando Dios nos ayuda, podemos hacer cosas que antes no podíamos hacer. Las personas iracundas dejan de serlo. Quienes no podían controlar su lujuria ahora tienen dominio propio. Las personas egoístas empiezan a poner a los demás en primer lugar. Las personas tímidas empiezan a predicar con valentía. Las personas avaras empiezan a dar a los demás. Dios hace una obra que los consejeros y los médicos no pueden hacer: cambia el mismo núcleo de una persona, y entonces todo se hace nuevo. Ahora vivimos para algo mucho mejor que lo que este mundo puede ofrecer; nos elevamos por el poder de Dios y mostramos a este mundo enfermo de pecado que ¡hay un camino mejor!

A lo largo de toda la Biblia, el pueblo de Dios hizo cosas sobrenaturales; no se conformó con llevar una vida agradable. Buscó algo más grande, algo mejor. Hay poder en la sangre de Jesús, pero fue necesario que hubiera una cruz para que eso fuera posible. También nosotros necesitamos una cruz para encontrar ese poder. Y les decía a todos: Si alguno quiere venir en pos de mí, niéguese a sí mismo, tome su cruz cada día y sígame. Porque todo el que quiera salvar su vida, la perderá; pero todo el que pierda su vida por causa de mí, ese la salvará –Lucas 9:23-24. Sí, parece una insensatez para los que perecen, pero para los que creen, es el poder de Dios.

Greetings of Christian love to each one. Another year has passed us by, and another is spread out before us to navigate. What is our perspective? Do we have hope and joy bubbling up in our hearts or does the future seem full of gloom and doom? Do we see God’s sovereign hand at work in the situations and circumstances around us or does the world seem out of control from our vantage point?

As I interact with folks from around the country there seems to be a common issue that many folks are struggling with—weariness. Weary of mandates. Weary of shutdowns. Weary of all the bickering and fighting that has surrounded the Covid issue. Weary of…

It appears that many people just “Don’t want to think about it”. Why? I’m really not sure what all the reasons are, but I am sure that each person has one. Let’s remember that God wants us to …be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves –Matthew 10:16.

Here, in the United States of America, Christians have had over 60 years (since World War 2) of relative peace and tranquility. For the most part, we have been left alone to raise our families and worship the God of our fathers according to our conscience. We have enjoyed the separation of Church and State that was implemented at the beginning of our country’s existence. We have been able to work with our hands and earn a living. Many of us have lived off the fat of the land.

Maybe we were living in an artificial bubble. Maybe we have been lulled into a false sense of security. What about our counterparts in countries around the world, what is their reality of living as true Christians in their world? Sure, we have been able to use our wealth and freedom of movement to do much good for the rest of the world who have endured much hardship due to following Christ. But at what cost? What have our children learned?

Sometimes, we hear about first generation Christians being “on fire” for their Lord. Sometimes so much so that second and third generation Christians think that first generation Christians are perhaps a little too zealous in their efforts of evangelizing those around them.

What about the next generation? They are learning from someone—about God, themselves, and life. What are they learning? And who are they learning from? We must take stock to ensure that our children are learning life’s lessons in a way that they will be prepared to face the reality of things to come.

And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world? And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many –Matthew 24:3-5.

Remember that this is Jesus Himself speaking to His followers regarding the end of the world. His very first concern is that we would NOT be deceived. He says that deception will be the major issue surrounding the end of time. He says that many will come claiming to be Christ [or His direct spokesperson] in an attempt to gain a listening ear, all in an effort to deceive the hearer and gain a following.

If not before now, we most certainly must be teaching our children certain specific things through word and action. That we are to be strangers and pilgrims as we journey through this life. That if we are friends of this world then God will be our enemy. And that Jesus’ Kingdom is not of this world, therefore, His children must learn to live as ambassadors in a foreign land. Our children need to know that ALL who live godly in Christ Jesus WILL suffer persecution.

Many of the doctrines that have been taught in our churches and para-church functions have severely crippled the next generation of the church. We have been taught that we can have the “power of His resurrection” without needing to be a partaker of the “fellowship of His sufferings”. A suffering Christ with suffering followers has been thrown out in favor of following a Jesus who will not let anything bad happen to you. While there is much emphasis on a Jesus who suffered and died for you, there is very little to NO teaching on the need to “take up your cross daily” and follow Him.

Mental Health and Emotional Stability

Some years ago, I came across the story of a soldier, who, after serving a term of service in Iraq, was struggling to cope with PTSD. Sure, I believe that PTSD is real, and the struggles are real, but as I read this man’s story, I found myself becoming increasingly frustrated with the lack of answers that were being provided to a severely struggling young man. Some of his deepest struggles stemmed from the flashback memories he had of when he had personally killed several of the enemy. No matter how many counseling sessions he went to he just couldn’t come to a place of inner peace and rest. His mind was troubled. He had difficulty sleeping. He had problems getting along with others.

I had to think “If only someone could come alongside this young man and share the Gospel of Jesus Christ with him. If only he could be shown the Truth of God’s Word that to take another human’s life is sin in God’s eyes (even if he is the enemy) and God will not allow him to have peace in his heart until that is taken care of. Also, that the real excitement is that IF he would come to God according to the terms of the Bible and repent of his sin, then he could start walking with God and God could start giving him peace for his troubled soul.”

Over the last number of years, there have been numerous mass shootings here in the United States. Each time the public officials hold news conferences and share their thoughts in an effort to try to make sense out of another seemingly unexplainable tragic event. Usually, it’s not long until someone is talking about mental health and the need to step up public efforts to provide safety nets, screenings, and better and more treatments to curb this senseless violence.

Several weeks ago, there was a terrible, tragic event that took place in another state from where I live. In one of the big cities, a man pushed a woman off of the platform and into the path of an oncoming subway train. She didn’t survive. In the aftermath of such a horrific happening, the public officials made statements to the public in an effort to stem the potential public fear. They concluded that the man must have been emotionally troubled and that they would be stepping up their efforts in trying to provide a safety net for those with mental health issues, so that such things wouldn’t happen again.

Sure, when we look at the issue through the eyes of the world it seems to make sense. But is this the whole of the matter? Have we as Christians become so used to the ways of the world that we forget how far they have strayed from the Truth of God’s Word?

Let’s not point our finger at the world and the elected public officials. Are we, as the church, any better? How well do we know our Bible? How well do we know our Savior? When someone comes to us seeking peace and rest within do we know how to take them to the Scriptures, and lead them to Jesus who can then show them the way to the Father?

Why am I saying all this? If we continue to provide the next generation of the church with artificial answers and temporary solutions to the problems of life, then they will NOT be prepared to …endure unto the end… –Matthew 24:13.

And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me. For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it –Luke 9:23-24.

Salamu za upendo wa Kikristo kwa kila mmoja. Mwaka mwingine umepita, na mwaka mwingine umetandazwa mbele yetu ili tupitie. Mtazamo wetu ni upi? Je, tuna tumaini na furaha vinavyobubujika mioyoni mwetu, au wakati ujao unaonekana kuwa umejaa huzuni na maangamizi? Je, tunaona mkono wa Mungu mwenye enzi ukitenda kazi katika hali na mazingira yanayotuzunguka, au kwa mtazamo wetu ulimwengu unaonekana kuwa nje ya udhibiti?

Ninapozungumza na watu kutoka maeneo mbalimbali ya nchi, inaonekana kuna jambo la kawaida ambalo watu wengi wanahangaikia—uchovu. Uchovu wa maagizo. Uchovu wa kufungwa kwa shughuli. Uchovu wa mabishano na mapigano yote yaliyohusiana na suala la Covid. Uchovu wa…

Inaonekana watu wengi hawataki tu “kulifikiria hilo”. Kwa nini? Sina hakika kabisa sababu zote ni zipi, lakini nina hakika kwamba kila mtu anayo sababu yake. Tukumbuke kwamba Mungu anataka tuwe …nao wenye busara kama nyoka, na wasio na hila kama hua –Mathayo 10:16.

Hapa, nchini Marekani, Wakristo wamekuwa na zaidi ya miaka 60 (tangu Vita vya Pili vya Dunia) ya amani na utulivu wa kadiri. Kwa sehemu kubwa, tumeachwa huru kulea familia zetu na kumwabudu Mungu wa baba zetu kulingana na dhamiri zetu. Tumefurahia utengano wa Kanisa na Serikali ulioanzishwa mwanzoni mwa uwepo wa nchi yetu. Tumeweza kufanya kazi kwa mikono yetu na kujipatia riziki. Wengi wetu tumeishi kwa neema ya nchi hii yenye utajiri.

Huenda tulikuwa tunaishi ndani ya kiputo cha bandia. Huenda tumetumbukizwa katika hali ya usalama wa uongo. Vipi kuhusu wenzetu katika nchi mbalimbali duniani; hali yao halisi ya kuishi kama Wakristo wa kweli katika ulimwengu wao ikoje? Ni kweli, tumeweza kutumia utajiri na uhuru wetu wa kutembea kutenda mema mengi kwa ajili ya watu wengine duniani ambao wamevumilia magumu mengi kwa sababu ya kumfuata Kristo. Lakini kwa gharama gani? Watoto wetu wamejifunza nini?

Nyakati nyingine, tunasikia kuhusu Wakristo wa kizazi cha kwanza kuwa “na bidii kubwa” kwa ajili ya Bwana wao. Nyakati nyingine, bidii hiyo huwa kubwa kiasi kwamba Wakristo wa kizazi cha pili na cha tatu hufikiri kwamba huenda Wakristo wa kizazi cha kwanza wana bidii nyingi kupita kiasi katika juhudi zao za kuwahubiria watu wanaowazunguka.

Vipi kuhusu kizazi kijacho? Wanajifunza kutoka kwa mtu fulani—kuhusu Mungu, wao wenyewe, na maisha. Wanajifunza nini? Na wanajifunza kutoka kwa nani? Ni lazima tufanye tathmini ili kuhakikisha kwamba watoto wetu wanajifunza masomo ya maisha kwa namna itakayowaandaa kukabiliana na hali halisi ya mambo yatakayokuja.

Na alipokuwa ameketi katika mlima wa Mizeituni, wanafunzi wakamwendea faraghani, wakisema, Tuambie, mambo hayo yatakuwa lini? Na ishara ya kuja kwako, na ya mwisho wa dunia ni nini? Yesu akajibu, akawaambia, Jihadharini mtu asiwadanganye. Kwa maana wengi watakuja kwa jina langu, wakisema, Mimi ndiye Kristo; nao watadanganya wengi –Mathayo 24:3-5.

Kumbukeni kwamba Yesu Mwenyewe ndiye anayezungumza hapa na wafuasi wake kuhusu mwisho wa dunia. Jambo lake la kwanza kabisa analohangaikia ni kwamba TUSIDANGANYWE. Anasema kwamba udanganyifu utakuwa suala kuu wakati wa mwisho. Anasema kwamba wengi watakuja wakidai kuwa Kristo [au msemaji wake wa moja kwa moja] ili wapate kusikilizwa, yote hayo yakiwa ni juhudi za kumdanganya msikilizaji na kujipatia wafuasi.

Kama hatukufanya hivyo hapo awali, bila shaka sasa ni lazima tuwafundishe watoto wetu mambo fulani mahususi kwa maneno na matendo. Kwamba tunapaswa kuwa wageni na wasafiri tunapopita katika maisha haya. Kwamba tukiwa marafiki wa ulimwengu huu, Mungu atakuwa adui yetu. Na kwamba Ufalme wa Yesu si wa ulimwengu huu; kwa hiyo, watoto wake lazima wajifunze kuishi kama mabalozi katika nchi ya kigeni. Watoto wetu wanahitaji kujua kwamba WOTE wanaoishi maisha ya kumcha Mungu katika Kristo Yesu WATAPATA mateso.

Mafundisho mengi yaliyofundishwa katika makanisa yetu na shughuli zinazohusiana na makanisa yamedhoofisha sana kizazi kijacho cha kanisa. Tumefundishwa kwamba tunaweza kuwa na “uwezo wa ufufuo wake” bila kuhitaji kushiriki “mateso yake”. Kristo anayeteseka pamoja na wafuasi wanaoteseka ametupiliwa mbali, na badala yake tunamfuata Yesu ambaye hataruhusu jambo lolote baya likupate. Ingawa kuna msisitizo mkubwa kuhusu Yesu aliyeteseka na kufa kwa ajili yako, kuna mafundisho machache sana, au HAKUNA kabisa, kuhusu haja ya “kuuchukua msalaba wako kila siku” na kumfuata.

Afya ya Akili na Utulivu wa Kihisia

Miaka kadhaa iliyopita, nilisoma hadithi ya mwanajeshi ambaye, baada ya kutumikia kipindi fulani nchini Iraq, alikuwa akihangaika kukabiliana na PTSD. Ni kweli, ninaamini kwamba PTSD ni hali halisi, na mapambano hayo ni halisi, lakini niliposoma hadithi ya mtu huyu, nilizidi kuchoshwa na ukosefu wa majibu yaliyokuwa yakitolewa kwa kijana aliyekuwa akihangaika sana. Baadhi ya mapambano yake makubwa zaidi yalitokana na kumbukumbu zilizokuwa zikimjia tena akilini kuhusu wakati alipowaua binafsi maadui kadhaa. Haidhuru alihudhuria vikao vingapi vya ushauri nasaha, hakuweza kamwe kufikia hali ya amani na pumziko la ndani. Akili yake ilikuwa na taabu. Alikuwa na shida ya kulala. Alikuwa na matatizo ya kuelewana na wengine.

Nilifikiri, “Laiti tu mtu fulani angeweza kumkaribia kijana huyu na kumshirikisha Injili ya Yesu Kristo. Laiti angeonyeshwa Ukweli wa Neno la Mungu kwamba kuua mwanadamu mwingine ni dhambi machoni pa Mungu (hata kama ni adui yake) na kwamba Mungu hatamruhusu kuwa na amani moyoni mwake mpaka jambo hilo lishughulikiwe. Pia, jambo la kusisimua kweli ni kwamba IKIWA angemjia Mungu kulingana na masharti ya Biblia na kutubu dhambi yake, basi angeweza kuanza kutembea na Mungu, naye Mungu angeweza kuanza kumpa amani kwa ajili ya nafsi yake yenye taabu.”

Katika miaka kadhaa iliyopita, kumekuwa na matukio mengi ya ufyatuaji risasi uliosababisha vifo vya watu wengi hapa Marekani. Kila mara, viongozi wa umma hufanya mikutano na waandishi wa habari na kueleza mawazo yao katika jitihada za kujaribu kuelewa tukio jingine la kusikitisha linaloonekana kuwa lisiloelezeka. Kwa kawaida, haichukui muda mrefu kabla mtu hajaanza kuzungumzia afya ya akili na haja ya kuongeza juhudi za umma za kuweka mifumo ya kinga, uchunguzi, na matibabu bora zaidi na mengi zaidi ili kuzuia vurugu hizi zisizo na maana.

Wiki kadhaa zilizopita, kulitokea tukio baya na la kusikitisha katika jimbo jingine tofauti na lile ninamoishi. Katika mojawapo ya majiji makubwa, mwanamume mmoja alimsukuma mwanamke kutoka kwenye jukwaa na kumtupa kwenye njia ya treni ya chini ya ardhi iliyokuwa inakuja. Mwanamke huyo hakunusurika. Baada ya tukio hilo la kutisha sana, viongozi wa umma walitoa kauli kwa umma katika jitihada za kupunguza hofu inayoweza kutokea miongoni mwa watu. Walihitimisha kwamba huenda mwanamume huyo alikuwa na matatizo ya kihisia na kwamba wangeongeza juhudi zao za kujaribu kuweka mifumo ya kinga kwa watu wenye matatizo ya afya ya akili, ili mambo kama hayo yasitokee tena.

Ni kweli, tunapolitazama suala hili kwa mtazamo wa ulimwengu, linaonekana kuwa na mantiki. Lakini je, hii ndiyo hali yote? Je, sisi Wakristo tumezoea sana njia za ulimwengu kiasi cha kusahau jinsi ulivyoiacha mbali kweli ya Neno la Mungu?

Tusielekeze kidole chetu kwa ulimwengu na viongozi wa umma waliochaguliwa. Je, sisi kama kanisa ni bora zaidi? Tunaijua Biblia yetu kwa kiwango gani? Tunamjua Mwokozi wetu kwa kiwango gani? Mtu anapokuja kwetu akitafuta amani na pumziko la ndani, je, tunajua jinsi ya kumpeleka kwenye Maandiko, na kumwongoza kwa Yesu ambaye anaweza kumwonyesha njia ya kwenda kwa Baba?

Kwa nini ninasema haya yote? Tukiendelea kukipa kizazi kijacho cha kanisa majibu ya bandia na suluhisho za muda kwa matatizo ya maisha, basi HAKITAKUWA tayari …kuvumilia hata mwisho… –Mathayo 24:13.

Akawaambia wote, Mtu yeyote akitaka kunifuata, na ajikane mwenyewe, ajitwike msalaba wake kila siku, anifuate. Kwa kuwa mtu yeyote atakayetaka kuiokoa nafsi yake ataipoteza; lakini mtu yeyote atakayeipoteza nafsi yake kwa ajili yangu, huyo ndiye atakayeiokoa –Luka 9:23-24.
